statement: For every pair of indices i,j with 0 <= i <= j < n, let max(i,j) be the maximum of the set {nums[k] : i <= k <= j}, let min(i,j) be the minimum of the same set, and let R(i,j) = max(i,j) - min(i,j). Whenever sub_array_ranges(nums) returns a result r, regarded as an integer, r = sum over all 0 <= i <= j < n of R(i,j).
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). Assume 1 <= n <= 1000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: sub_array_ranges(nums) returns a result r; it does not panic, go out of bounds, or overflow.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). Assume 1 <= n <= 1000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever sub_array_ranges(nums) returns a result r, regarded as an integer, r >= 0.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). Assume 1 <= n <= 1000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Let M = max {nums[k] : 0 <= k < n} and m = min {nums[k] : 0 <= k < n}. Whenever sub_array_ranges(nums) returns a result r, regarded as an integer, r >= M - m.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). Assume 1 <= n <= 1000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Let M = max {nums[k] : 0 <= k < n} and m = min {nums[k] : 0 <= k < n}. Whenever sub_array_ranges(nums) returns a result r, regarded as an integer, r <= (n*(n-1)/2) * (M - m).
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). Assume 1 <= n <= 1000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever sub_array_ranges(nums) returns a result r, regarded as an integer, r = 0.
Whenever sub_array_ranges(nums) returns a result r, regarded as an integer, r = absolute_value(nums[0] - nums[1]).

Whenever sub_array_ranges(nums) returns a result r, regarded as an integer, r = 0 if and only if all elements of nums are equal, that is, for every i,j with 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n, nums[i] = nums[j].
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). Assume 1 <= n <= 1000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever sub_array_ranges(nums) returns a result r, regarded as an integer, r = sum over all 0 <= i <= j < n of (nums[j] - nums[i]).
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). Assume 1 <= n <= 1000, for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9, and nums is nondecreasing: for every i with 0 <= i < n-1, nums[i] <= nums[i+1].

statement: Whenever sub_array_ranges(nums) returns a result r and sub_array_ranges(rev) returns a result r', both regarded as integers, r = r'.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). Assume 1 <= n <= 1000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9. Let rev be the array of length n with rev[i] = nums[n-1-i] for 0 <= i < n; then rev also has all entries in {-10^9,...,10^9}.

statement: Whenever sub_array_ranges(nums) returns a result r and sub_array_ranges(neg) returns a result r', both regarded as integers, r = r'.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). Assume 1 <= n <= 1000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9. Let neg be the array of length n with neg[i] = -nums[i] for 0 <= i < n; then neg also has all entries in {-10^9,...,10^9}.

statement: Whenever sub_array_ranges(nums) returns a result r and sub_array_ranges(shifted) returns a result r', both regarded as integers, r = r'.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). Assume 1 <= n <= 1000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9. Let c be an integer such that for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10^9 <= nums[i] + c <= 10^9, and let shifted be the array with shifted[i] = nums[i] + c.

statement: Whenever sub_array_ranges(nums) returns a result r and sub_array_ranges(scaled) returns a result r', both regarded as integers, r' = k * r.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). Assume 1 <= n <= 1000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9. Let k be an integer with k >= 0 such that for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10^9 <= k*nums[i] <= 10^9, and let scaled be the array with scaled[i] = k*nums[i].

statement: For every 0 <= i <= j < n, define max(i,j) as the maximum of {nums[k] : i <= k <= j} and min(i,j) as the minimum of the same set. Whenever sub_array_ranges(nums) returns a result r, regarded as an integer, r = (sum over all 0 <= i <= j < n of max(i,j)) - (sum over all 0 <= i <= j < n of min(i,j)).
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). Assume 1 <= n <= 1000 and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.
